Desktop distribution and update manager for Resolve/OpenFX tools, with DCTL-to-OFX conversion and NexControl MIDI mapping. Plugin licenses remain separate. The developer platform also provides licensing/commerce infrastructure; community distribution is free, with separate commercial developer plans. Per-plugin host and GPU requirements still apply.
Community distribution and commercial developer plans differ; do not treat all hosted plugins as free.
